content_data.meeting_title: Fintech Core System Integration - Phase 1 Review & Next Steps
agenda_items: Discussion of identified technical roadblocks and mitigation strategies
Planning for Phase 2 rollout: account management & fraud detection modules
Analysis of initial pilot user feedback and performance metrics
Resource allocation and timeline adjustments for upcoming period
key_decisions: Schedule a dedicated technical deep-dive session on data migration strategy for the upcoming period.
Approve the proposed change request for integrating the new KYC vendor's enhanced identity verification service.
Prioritize resolution of API latency issues identified in payment gateway integration within the next 7 days.
Allocate an additional full-time equivalent (FTE) from the internal development team to support Phase 2 integration efforts for the next 4 weeks.
action_items: **Sofia Rodriguez (Product Lead):** Consolidate and present a summary of all pilot user feedback, highlighting critical issues, by next meeting.
**Consultant (Self):** Prepare a comparative analysis of potential fraud detection systems for review in 2 weeks.
